assets.name: cat_orange
assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Create a production game sprite and Meshy image-to-3D reference for Purr & Tangle: a single adorable orange tabby cat, full body, large round head, short rounded paws, compact pear body, tail curled against body, distinct dark terracotta stripes on forehead and sides, ivory muzzle, warm amber eyes. Front view with very slight three-quarter volume but both ears and all four feet clearly visible. Original premium cozy clay-toy 3D illustration, soft matte material, simple sculpted forms, gentle studio lighting, crisp readable silhouette at 48 pixels. Centered fills 85% of square canvas. Actual transparent background. Exactly one character, no accessories, no ground plane, no text, no border, no cast shadow beyond subject. Body and tail form a connected solid suitable for 3D modeling.

splash.name: boot_splash
splash.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: finished startup splash image for the desktop puzzle game Purr & Tangle, replacing an engine logo.
Scene/backdrop: clean warm ivory background (#f4efdf), with generous plain ivory margins and a soft grounding shadow, no frame.
Subject: three adorable original clay-toy cats sitting close together around a small warm wicker basket of chunky yarn balls. The central cat is an orange tabby with dark terracotta stripes, an ivory muzzle and amber eyes; the blue-gray cat has dark indigo spots, a pale muzzle and sleepy eyes; the lavender-purple cat has bold violet zigzag markings, an ivory muzzle and a mischievous tiny smile. Large round heads, small rounded paws, compact pear-shaped bodies and connected curled tails. The yarn colors are orange, blue-gray and purple, with tiny kitten eyes peeking from one yarn ball.
Style/medium: polished cozy 3D clay-toy illustration, sculpted matte surfaces, clean friendly silhouettes, soft studio light, matching a gentle cat-and-yarn puzzle game. Rich clear colors, no realistic fur.
Composition: landscape approximately 4:3, centered balanced splash layout. Large elegant friendly dark forest-green serif title in the upper third, three cats and basket grouped beneath in the middle/lower middle. Keep the complete title, ears and tails safely inside the central 80% with ample ivory breathing room on all edges. Image should remain legible when scaled to a 990 by 810 game window.
Text (verbatim): "Purr & Tangle". Render this exact title correctly and clearly. No other text.
Avoid: Godot or any other engine logos, watermarks, UI buttons, progress bars, extra cats, clutter, gradients at the outer edges, cropped subjects. Opaque background.
